material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: dark angular rock, 0.75 x 0.6 x 0.45 m, crusted with blue-green mineral and a cluster of small blue crystal prisms on top
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: A sphere cut by random break planes and gently displaced: edges are soft, with no undercuts, overhangs or split-off slabs, and the base is a flat clip rather than a buried foot with soil piled against it. One rock scan, box projected and tinted, carries all surface detail; its features do not follow the displaced form. Moss and lichen are procedural masks. The blue mineral is a glossy colour mask on the rock plus nine plain prisms; it is not a modelled crystal druse and has no transmission or internal colour.
